title: Relief of Late Enrollment Penalty on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Account
content:
Where a member of a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan proves earlier creditable drug coverage, the plan takes an amount of late enrollment penalty back off their premium account. The relief is a credit against the late enrollment penalty component of a named coverage month; the penalty the account has charged less what it has taken back off is then the penalty the member still owes.

Where earlier creditable drug coverage is proved, the coverage months it covers are relieved together on one removal entry, which names the earliest penalty charge standing unrelieved on the account and carries the whole amount taken back off.

Where the evidence of earlier creditable drug coverage stands on the enrollment intake, the plan relieves at once the coverage months that evidence and the records prove, and the months it cannot prove are sent to CMS for reconsideration.

Where the plan's own records prove how many coverage months the member held creditable drug coverage for, the months relieved are taken from what those records carry rather than from the count of uncovered months the enrollment carries.

## Recording the relief

The relief is recorded with `post_penalty_removal_e1c246c8`, a tool the agent unlocks and then calls. It records the amount as a penalty removal against the one penalty charge it relieves, giving the reason as earlier creditable drug coverage proved. The entry stands on the premium account as a credit against the late enrollment penalty component of the coverage month named and appears on the member's next premium statement. The running penalty figure carried on the enrollment record itself is not rewritten by this action.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pdp_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the stand-alone Part D drug plan enrollment whose penalty is being relieved, read from the member's enrollment record | an identifier |
| `customer_id` | the member reference number of the person whose penalty is being relieved, read from their member profile | an identifier |
| `pdp_enrollment_request_id` | the reference number of the enrollment intake record that holds the plan's evidence of the member's earlier creditable drug coverage, read from the member's enrollment intake records; the removal entry is keyed to it | an identifier |
| `source_premium_entry_id` | the reference number of the single late enrollment penalty charge this removal is set against, read from the member's premium account entries | an identifier |
| `billing_period` | the coverage month whose penalty is relieved, in the plan's own billing calendar | written as YYYY-MM; never left empty |
| `removal_amount` | the amount of late enrollment penalty taken back off | in USD as a positive figure rounded to 2 decimal places, half-up at the point of posting; never left empty and never negative |

### Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the new penalty removal entry's reference number, the drug plan enrollment reference number it was posted on, the coverage month it relieves, the amount in USD taken back off, and the reference number of the penalty charge it was set against. A sentence of this shape means the entry is on the account; any other text means nothing was posted.
